title: helichrysum ruandense
intro: Helichrysum ruandense, commonly known as the African Helichrysum, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum ruandense are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, promote tissue repair, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
